findings.message: The closing phrase 'the feet where the hymn began' does not come from any pada of v9. It is a cross-reference to verse 1, and annotation a1 supports it with the 'pāvanāṅghripaṅkaja' quote in vanivilas-1910-works-18. The claim is accurate, but the bhāvārtha now adds content that is not in the verse. A human should decide whether the bhāvārtha may carry this link or whether it belongs only in annotation a1.
findings.suggested_fix: End at '...will surely come into the presence of Kālabhairava's feet.' and leave the link back to verse 1 to annotation a1.

findings.message: Same as the EN bhāvārtha: 'उन्हीं चरणों तक जहाँ से स्तोत्र आरम्भ हुआ था' is a link back to verse 1 and is found in no pada of v9. It is accurate and annotation a1 already makes this point.
findings.suggested_fix: End at '...वे निश्चय ही कालभैरव के चरणों की सन्निधि में पहुँच जाते हैं।' and leave the link back to verse 1 to annotation a1.
